conflicts.subject: Jinko JKM585N-72HL4-BDV
conflicts.issue: F2-US vs F9-EN electrical values differ; neither supplier offer establishes revision
conflicts.action: Keep separate spec records; exact nameplate and datasheet mapping required.

conflicts.subject: Deye SE-F5
conflicts.issue: SE-F5-L vs family label; Thrillhouse advertises 50A continuous discharge and 90% DoD vs D01 120A and recommended 80%
conflicts.action: Do not promote offer to exact match; obtain serial/nameplate and applicable manual.

conflicts.subject: itel IPV-6K48U Pro
conflicts.issue: NIKADE dual MPPT vs I01 one MPPT; Thrillhouse 100A charge vs I01 120A
conflicts.action: Keep manufacturer figures per revision; do not assume two trackers.

conflicts.subject: itel IPV-8K48T
conflicts.issue: Thrillhouse lists 500V/85–450V and 30+15 vs I02 535V/75–500V and 30+20; appears similar to IPV-8K48U
conflicts.action: Keep T/U distinct; confirm revision, short-circuit rating and PV terminals.

conflicts.subject: itel IHY-6K6L1C / IHY-8KL3
conflicts.issue: NIKADE describes high-voltage battery; I04/I05 state 48V nominal, 40–60V range
conflicts.action: Never classify 1000V PV input as battery voltage; use document-specific phase and battery specs.

conflicts.subject: itel IPL-25200X
conflicts.issue: Thrillhouse 25.6V nominal but 40–57.6V range incompatible; I08 has 28.8V charge and 23.5V cutoff settings
conflicts.action: Do not approve until exact official model specification available.

conflicts.subject: itel IPL-51314H
conflicts.issue: I07 headline discharge power exceeds current-table-derived capability; supplier IP21 vs I07 IP20
conflicts.action: Use conservative current-based screen, not headline surge; verify manual and revision.
